nodes.label: Monorepo Architecture
nodes.rationale: Monorepo layout: client, server, shared (@ramadan-tournament/shared for birth-year bounds and Israeli ID validation), data/, docs/ canonical docs, .incoming/ for new doc drops. Prisma ORM with boys/girls as separate seasons (division); Redis caches hot reads (rt: keys). Core tournament automation runs in Node.js API; Python limited to peripheral scripts under scripts/.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL + Redis Stack
nodes.rationale: Frontend: React 19, Vite 7, TypeScript, Bootstrap 5, PWA, react-helmet-async. Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (Prisma), Redis (ioredis). Bootstrap via npm run db:migrate and db:seed; clean start via db:fresh. DevOps: Render (API + Postgres + Redis), Vercel (frontend).

nodes.label: Registration Service Split
nodes.rationale: Registration split into RegistrationQueryService, RegistrationWorkflowService, RegistrationIdentityService; admin roster via TeamRosterService; public reads via TeamDataService. Legacy models/User.ts Mongoose shim remains for auth/profile.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Personal ID Registration
nodes.rationale: Symmetric flow: admin or user enters personal ID + birth year first; active only when encrypted ID and birth year match; then join or team-creation request with admin approval. AES-256-GCM storage (userPersonalIdEnc, adminPersonalIdEnc); admin APIs return masked ID (last 4 digits) only; Redis rate limit 3/day on failed identity submissions.

nodes.label: Python Peripheral Automation
nodes.rationale: Core stats/AI/CSV imports run natively in Node.js API. Python strictly for photo sync, Postgres CSV backup, external alarm fetch under scripts/, driven by .github/workflows/. archive/postgres/ treated as sensitive PII.

nodes.label: Israeli Standard IS 5568 (WCAG 2.1 AA)
nodes.rationale: Legal requirement in Israel for all UI changes. Resources: .cursor/rules/israeli-accessibility-is5568.mdc, docs/review/is-5568-wcag-aa-pass-may-2026.md, status.md checklist, client Accessibility.tsx public statement.

nodes.label: Dual Tournament UI Themes
nodes.rationale: Boys (data-tournament=boys, green/yellow tokens.css), girls (data-tournament=girls, pastel rose/lavender tournament-girls.css), World Cup temporary branch (data-tournament=worldcup, blue/gold, football-data.org proxy).

nodes.label: Agent Documentation Continuity
nodes.rationale: Canonical docs at docs/README.md. Implementation handoff: .cursor/agent-rtm.md to docs/agent/HANDOFF.md. Business rules: docs/server/BUSINESS_LOGIC.md. Frontend: docs/client/ARCHITECTURE.md.

nodes.label: MongoDB Stack Guidance (Legacy)
nodes.rationale: GEMINI.md still describes React 18, Node/Express, MongoDB Atlas/Mongoose stack and MERN patterns; superseded by PostgreSQL/Prisma per context.md and status.md.

nodes.label: AutomationService Stats and AI
nodes.rationale: Node.js AutomationService tracks tournament stats and posts news. Trigger: Admin Panel or POST /api/admin/trigger-automation. Uses stats_snapshots for change detection and Gemini for Hebrew summaries.

nodes.label: Project Structure Overview
nodes.rationale: Monorepo: client/ React frontend, server/ Node backend, .github/workflows/ for backup-postgres, fetch-alarms, sync-photos, scripts/ Python automation (backup_postgres.py, fetch_alarms.py, sync_photos.py).

nodes.label: ramadan-tournament-api Web Service
nodes.rationale: Render web service: Node env, Frankfurt region, free plan. buildCommand: npm install && node scripts/render-api-build.mjs. startCommand: npm start --workspace=server. healthCheckPath: /api/health. Env: DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_*, WORLD_CUP_ENABLED=true, WORLD_CUP_ONLY=false, FOOTBALL_DATA_API_KEY.

nodes.label: Phase 1.5 and Phase 2 Progress
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 live on Render; Phase 1.5 girls read path in progress; Phase 2 registration with personal ID + birth year. PR1-PR5 server cleanup merged. Vitest CI via test.yml. Python scripts moved to scripts/.

nodes.rationale: Vitest in shared/ and server/; root npm run test builds shared then runs both workspaces. CI: .github/workflows/test.yml on PRs and push to main/master.

nodes.rationale: Official Adygea flag motif: green field (#296912) with twelve yellow (#FDFC02) stars and three arrows arranged in mirrored halves — symbol of Circassian (Adyghe) heritage linked to Kfar Kama's Circassian community.

nodes.label: Header Right Corner Cultural Watermark

Banners read FOOTBALL LEAGUE / RAMADAN TOURNAMENT. Symmetrical prestige composition fusing sport, Islam, and Caucasian culture.

nodes.label: default.jpg — default player head placeholder
nodes.description: Static client-side fallback avatar when a roster player has no approved head_photo. AI-generated illustration: bearded man in Circassian traditional dress (black papakha, red chokha with gazyrs, kama dagger) standing arms-crossed on a green soccer pitch inside a stadium. Blue sideline banners read CIRKASSIAN LEAGUE SUMMER CUP; mosque minaret and green dome visible beyond the stands. Three soccer balls on the field. Cultural/regional soccer tournament aesthetic rather than a generic silhouette placeholder.

nodes.label: team_10_1773085380856.jpg — team 10 logo upload
nodes.description: Nighttime group photo of five men in matching light-gray referee polo shirts on green artificial turf, not a graphic team crest. Hebrew caption banner: וכמובן השופטים שלנו המיוחדים באפור (And of course our special referees in gray). Whistles on lanyards (yellow, red, blue). Chain-link fence and distant players in background. Stored under uploads/logos/ with team_10 naming convention but visually documents tournament officiating staff.

nodes.label: team_1_1773175168061.jpeg — team 1 logo upload
nodes.description: Circular Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) crest: green inner field, black outer ring with white text NIGERIA FOOTBALL FEDERATION, year 1945 flanked by stars, stylized white eagle with spread wings perched on a classic black-and-white soccer ball. National green-white-black palette. Standard federation badge suitable as team logoUrl branding asset.

nodes.label: player_101_1771879064750.jpg — player 101 head upload
nodes.description: Professional goalkeeper headshot resembling Gianluigi Buffon: dark hair, stubble, direct gaze. Bright orange Juventus goalkeeper jersey with Adidas logo, Juventus crest and three gold stars, Scudetto and Coccarda championship badges. Dark blurred background. Portrait orientation suitable for roster head_photo display.

nodes.label: player_104_1771870731981.jpg — player 104 photo upload
nodes.description: Professional match action photograph, not a headshot: Juan Cuadrado (Juventus, black-white striped Jeep kit) standing over Sergio Ramos (Real Madrid, purple Fly Emirates kit) performing a sliding tackle. Adidas Finale match ball, grass clippings, blurred stadium crowd. UEFA Champions League final-era stock imagery uploaded as player asset.

nodes.label: player_177_1771884844890.jpeg — player 177 photo upload
nodes.description: Dynamic action frame: adult male striker in light-blue jersey, navy shorts, white socks, yellow cleats executing a powerful right-foot kick. White shard-like motion trail around ball. Background: training pitch, chain-link fence, Gazprom G-logo boards and orange G-DRIVE racing-car ad. Kit and sponsors suggest Zenit Saint Petersburg aesthetic. Action shot rather than portrait headshot.

nodes.label: Default Player Avatar Placeholder
nodes.rationale: When resolveAssetUrl(selectedPlayer.head_photo) is falsy, Teams modal falls back to /assets/images/players/heads/default.jpg. onError further replaces with inline gray SVG data URI. Bundled static asset under client/public/assets/images/players/heads/ — not served from API uploads.

nodes.label: Player Head Photo Asset
nodes.rationale: Players upload photos via POST; multer stores to uploads/players/player_{memberId}_{timestamp}{ext}. URL saved as pending_head_photo until admin approval promotes to head_photo. Also used for user avatarUrl sync. Served at /uploads/players/ on API origin; client resolves via resolveAssetUrl.

nodes.label: Team Logo Asset
nodes.rationale: Team owners/admins upload branding via uploadTeamLogo; file saved as uploads/logos/team_{teamId}_{timestamp}{ext}. team.logoUrl set to /uploads/logos/{filename}. Requires canManageTeamBranding permission.

nodes.label: Asset URL Resolution
nodes.rationale: resolveAssetUrl routes assets/ and /assets/ paths to Vite client origin; /uploads/ paths to VITE_API_URL server; http(s) and data: unchanged. Central resolver for head_photo, logoUrl, and pending_head_photo display.

nodes.label: Sync Production Photos Workflow
nodes.rationale: Python script downloads production /uploads/logos/ and /uploads/players/ files referenced in team logoUrl and player head_photo/pending_head_photo fields. Driven by .github/workflows/sync-photos.yml. Local copies mirror Render uploads for dev/backup.
